newsitem.title: USA: Feb daily copper center shipments rise 4.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Feb daily copper center shipments rise 4.4 percent.

text.p: Average daily shipping rates from U.S. copper and brass service centers rose 4.4 percent over January, the Copper & Brass Servicenter Association said.
But with two fewer shipping days in February, total shipments for the month were 5.1 percent below January's figure.
In two product categories, copper plate and alloy pipe and tube, month to month gains were registered.
As of Feb 28, total copper shipments were up 12.6 percent and alloy shipments up 5.9 percent, year-to-year.

"We are certainly hopeful that trend will continue, although there are scattered reports of minor declines in the shipment levels being realized by some servicenters over the last two weeks," CBSA said in a statement.
